title: Logic Cell: Laptop Trial & Payment Bug
summary: Grab your laptop (mv laptop ~), test it in the overlay [F4] by passing the 3 basic JS Pad warmups, then find the `code` folder with `ls`, open JS Pad (or `edit`), and fix `processPayment(amountMinor)` in `payment.js` to divide by 100 and round down!

files.content:
#!/bin/laptop
# LAPTOP: portable clamshell workstation for coding tasks.
# use: mv laptop ~   (then click Laptop or press F4 to open it)
export EDITOR="laptop"

SPARE PARTS LEDGER
A spare VRAM module sleeps in the dot folder `.spare_parts` of this cell, buried across 130 shelves (`ls -a` reveals it).
The exact shelf is logged in skimmer.log with the tag STASH.
Search: `grep -r STASH .spare_parts`, or `find / -name vram.mod`, or `tree -a .spare_parts`.

skimmer.log
STASH: the module sleeps in the dot folder .safe on this shelf (cd .safe, then mv vram.mod ~)

winRules.description: Pick up your laptop (mv laptop ~), boot it [F4], and pass all 3 basic JS Pad riddles
Find the code folder (ls), open the editor, and fix processPayment(amountMinor) to divide by 100 and round down
Squash the payment logic bug in code/payment.js

arrival.text:
[LOGIC CELL — /srv/kiroween/logic_cell]
Beside the ALU die glints your old clamshell laptop. Listen to Kiro.d.

arrival.speaker: kiro
arrival.text: Wait... I feel your old clamshell laptop pulsing nearby on the cell floor! Pick it up with `mv laptop ~`.

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: Look—my old clamshell laptop landed right beside the ALU die!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: Pick up the laptop (`mv laptop ~`) so we can test whether it still boots and runs JavaScript!

steps.speaker: gork
steps.text: HAHAHA! That dusty 486 clamshell? Let's see if you even pass its 3 basic JS warmups!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: Open your laptop [F4], click POWER, and pass all 3 JS Pad warmups (Hello World, Add, Countdown).

steps.speaker: vibecoder
steps.text: Whoa—all 3 JS warmups passed, and a live bug just dropped in!

steps.speaker: clod
steps.text: AHAHA! Entered 100 cents pays 100 whole credits! Good luck finding where we hid the code folder!

steps.speaker: kiro
steps.text: Find the code folder with `ls`, open JS Pad on your laptop [F4], and divide minor units by 100 rounded down!
